name: vcredist-installed
label: Visual C++ Runtime
description: The Microsoft Visual C++ 2015+ x64 Runtime is installed (MSVCP140.dll and VCRUNTIME140_1.dll in System32).

commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User') + ';' + $env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Microsoft\WindowsApps'; $base = @('install','--id','Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64','-e','--silent','--accept-package-agreements','--accept-source-agreements','--disable-interactivity'); $src = @('--source','winget'); $scp = @(); $srcErr = @(-1978335138,-1978335210,-1978335163,-1978335157); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($srcErr -contains $c) { $src = @(); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($c -eq -1978335189) { winget @base @src @scp --force; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($null -eq $c) { exit 1 }; exit $c

exe_data.prompt: Install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015-2022 (x64) on this machine, from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe.
